name: Jewelry Invoice & Certificate Generator
author: Vimal Kava

sections.description:
Jewelry Invoice & Certificate Generator is a WooCommerce plugin designed for jewelry stores, jewelers, precious metal businesses, gemstone stores, and online jewelry shops.

It helps you manage your store information, invoices, taxes, certificates, currency, invoice templates, and WhatsApp invoice sharing from one simple settings panel.

Create professional customer documents for your WooCommerce orders and customize them according to your business requirements.

Perfect for:

  • Jewelry stores and jewelers
  • Gold and silver businesses
  • Precious metal stores
  • Gemstone and diamond businesses
  • Online jewelry stores
  • WooCommerce jewelry websites
  • Businesses that need professional invoices and certificates

Demo & Video Guide

🎬 Watch the Video Guide

See how Jewelry Invoice & Certificate Generator works and learn how to configure the plugin for your WooCommerce jewelry store.

▶ Watch on YouTube: Click here to watch the video

🚀 Try the Live Demo

Want to explore the plugin before installing it?

Visit our live demo and test the available invoice, tax, certificate, currency, template, and WhatsApp settings.

  • Demo Website: Click here to open the live demo
  • Username: jewelry-invoice-and-certificate-generator
  • Password: jicgplugin@123

Please use the demo for testing purposes only. Do not enter personal, financial, payment, or confidential information.

Key Features

  • Professional WooCommerce invoice generation
  • Jewelry purchase certificate generation
  • Store information and branding settings
  • Shop logo support
  • Custom invoice number prefix
  • Custom invoice footer notes
  • Optional PAID watermark
  • Multiple tax modes
  • GST India tax mode
  • International tax mode
  • Simple single-rate tax mode
  • Custom tax rate configuration
  • WooCommerce currency integration
  • Invoice template settings
  • Automatic certificate generation
  • Custom certificate title and description
  • Certificate background image support
  • Certificate signature image support
  • Certificate stamp image support
  • WhatsApp invoice sharing
  • Custom WhatsApp message
  • Easy-to-use settings panel
  • Customization services available

Store Settings

Configure your jewelry store information directly from the plugin settings.

You can add:

  • Shop Name
  • Shop Logo
  • Shop Address
  • Shop Phone
  • Shop Email

Your store details can be used throughout your generated invoices and certificates.

Invoice Settings

Create professional invoices and configure the invoice settings according to your business requirements.

Available settings include:

  • Invoice Number Prefix
  • Custom Footer Note
  • PAID Watermark

Invoice Number Prefix

Set your own invoice number prefix.

Example:

INV-2026-001

You can customize the prefix according to your business or accounting requirements.

Footer Note

Add a custom message at the bottom of your invoices.

Example:

Thank you for your business!

PAID Watermark

Enable a PAID watermark on completed WooCommerce orders.

This makes it easy for customers and store administrators to identify invoices for completed orders.

Tax Settings

Configure your tax settings according to your business and target market.

Available tax modes include:

  • Simple (Single Rate)
  • GST India
  • International

You can also configure the applicable tax rate where supported.

The GST India option is designed for jewelry businesses operating in India that need GST-based invoice configuration.

Certificate Settings

Automatically generate purchase certificates for orders containing jewelry.

Certificate settings include:

  • Enable or disable automatic certificate generation
  • Certificate Title
  • Certificate Background Image
  • Certificate Description
  • Signature Image
  • Stamp Image

Automatic Certificate Generation

Enable automatic certificate generation for orders containing jewelry.

Certificate Title

Set your own certificate title.

Example:

Certificate of Authenticity

Certificate Description

Add your own certificate description or business-specific certification text.

Certificate Branding

Upload your own:

  • Certificate background
  • Signature
  • Business stamp

This allows you to create certificates that better match your jewelry brand.

Currency Settings

The plugin automatically loads the base currency configured in WooCommerce.

For example:

USD ($)

The base currency is automatically loaded from WooCommerce and cannot be changed directly from the plugin’s Currency settings.

To change the currency, update the currency settings in WooCommerce.

Invoice Templates

Choose the available invoice template from the plugin settings.

The template settings allow you to select the invoice design available in your plugin installation.

Additional invoice designs and layouts can also be developed through our customization service.

WhatsApp Invoice Sharing

Make it easier for customers to receive their invoice through WhatsApp.

You can enable the WhatsApp Share Button on the WooCommerce order confirmation page.

You can also customize the default WhatsApp message.

Example:

Hello {customer_name}, here is your invoice from {shop_name}. Total: {amount}.

The message can be configured according to your communication requirements.

Customization Services

Need something different for your jewelry business?

We can customize the plugin based on your specific business requirements.

Available customization services include:

  • Custom Invoice Designs
  • Custom Certificate Layouts
  • Tax & GST Customization
  • Custom Pricing & Fields
  • Email & WhatsApp Integration
  • Custom Invoice Information
  • Custom Templates
  • Business-specific Features
  • Other Custom Requirements

Examples of possible customizations:

  • Custom invoice layouts
  • Custom certificate designs
  • Additional jewelry-related fields
  • Custom tax calculations
  • Business-specific pricing logic
  • Additional customer or order information
  • Custom WhatsApp workflows
  • Email integrations
  • Custom document requirements

Customization requests may involve additional development charges depending on the required work.

How to Request Customization

Send your requirements to:

kavavimal@gmail.com

Please include:

  • A short description of what you need
  • Your business requirements
  • Screenshots or examples, if available
  • Any specific invoice or certificate format you want

We will review your requirements and provide a suitable customization solution.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Jewelry Invoice.
  6. Configure your store, invoice, tax, certificate, currency, template, and WhatsApp settings.
  7. Save your changes.

Your WooCommerce jewelry store is now ready to use the configured invoice and certificate features.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Jewelry Invoice & Certificate Generator is designed for WooCommerce stores.

Can I add my shop logo?

Yes. You can upload your shop logo from the General settings.

Can I add my shop address and contact information?

Yes. You can configure your shop name, logo, address, phone number, and email address.

Can I customize my invoice number prefix?

Yes. You can configure your preferred invoice number prefix.

Can I add a custom footer to invoices?

Yes. You can add your own footer note to invoices.

Can I show a PAID watermark?

Yes. You can enable the PAID watermark for completed orders.

Does the plugin support GST?

Yes. The plugin includes a GST India tax mode along with Simple Single Rate and International tax modes.

Can I set my own tax rate?

Yes. You can configure the applicable tax rate from the Tax settings.

Does the plugin support international stores?

Yes. The plugin includes an International tax mode and uses the currency configured in WooCommerce.

Can I generate jewelry certificates?

Yes. The plugin can automatically generate certificates for orders containing jewelry.

Can I customize the certificate title and description?

Yes. You can configure your own certificate title and description.

Can I add my own certificate background?

Yes. You can upload a custom certificate background image.

Can I add a signature and stamp to the certificate?

Yes. You can upload signature and stamp images from the Certificate settings.

Can I customize the certificate design?

The plugin provides several certificate customization options. If you require a completely different certificate layout, custom development is available.

Can I share invoices through WhatsApp?

Yes. You can enable the WhatsApp Share Button on the WooCommerce order confirmation page.

Can I customize the WhatsApp message?

Yes. You can configure the default WhatsApp message according to your requirements.

Does the plugin use WooCommerce currency settings?

Yes. The plugin automatically loads the base currency configured in WooCommerce.

Can I try the plugin before installing it?

Yes. You can try the live demo using the demo credentials provided above.

Is customization available?

Yes. We provide customization services for jewelry businesses, including invoice designs, certificates, tax and GST requirements, custom fields, WhatsApp integration, and other business-specific requirements.

How can I request customization?

Send your requirements to kavavimal@gmail.com with a description of the functionality you need. Screenshots or examples are also helpful.
